instructions: Use this template as the foundation for Express TypeScript APIs intended for ECS Fargate.
Do not regenerate protected package/config/Docker files unless the user explicitly asks for dependency or Docker changes.
Use the protected requestLogger and errorHandler middleware from src/middleware.
Use the protected success and error response helpers from src/common/response.ts.
Build output is dist/server.js because tsconfig rootDir is src and outDir is dist.
The Dockerfile is known-good for Node.js 20, npm ci, TypeScript build, and npm start.
